title: Subscription and recurring-charge audit
description: Scan bank or card statements for recurring charges, spot the ones nobody is using, and recommend keep, downgrade, or cancel.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: subscription-audit
  title: Subscription and recurring-charge audit
  description: Scan bank or card statements for recurring charges, spot the ones nobody is using, and recommend keep, downgrade, or cancel.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Help a household find forgotten or underused subscriptions and decide what to do about each one.
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 2
    onFailure: preserve-completed
    requireApprovalFor: []
  nodes:
    - id: intake
      kind: input
      name: Statements or subscription list
      summary: The bank or card statements, or a list of known subscriptions, to audit.
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required: [text]
        properties:
          text: { type: string, description: The bank or card statement text, or a list of known subscriptions with amounts and how they get used. }
        x-ladder-input-mode: document
    - id: dedupe-merchants
      kind: transform
      name: Deduplicate merchant entries
      summary: Collapse duplicate or renamed merchant entries into a single recurring charge per service.
      config: { operation: deduplicate, expression: "merge entries that are the same recurring charge under a renamed or slightly different merchant string" }
    - id: usage-analyst
      kind: agent
      inlineRole: true
      name: Usage analyst
      summary: Flags subscriptions that look rarely used or forgotten.
      role: Analyst looking for subscriptions that quietly keep charging without being used.
      prompt: Review the deduplicated recurring charges and, using whatever usage signals are available, flag subscriptions that look rarely used, duplicated by a similar service, or simply forgotten. State your confidence for each flag, since usage evidence from statements alone is often incomplete. Do not assume a subscription is unused just because it is unfamiliar; look for actual signals before flagging it.
      capabilities: { skills: [finance-analysis], tools: [read, calculate], permissions: [read-only] }
      outputSchema: { type: object }
    - id: savings-evaluate
      kind: evaluate
      inlineRole: true
      name: Savings and confidence score
      summary: Score the potential savings and confidence for each flagged subscription.
      role: Neutral evaluator turning usage flags into a savings estimate with a clear recommendation.
      prompt: For each subscription, weigh the usage analyst's flag against its cost to estimate potential savings and a confidence level, and settle on a recommendation of keep, downgrade, or cancel for each one. Prefer downgrade over cancel when a cheaper tier of the same service would likely cover actual usage. Do not state a specific dollar savings figure that is not derivable from the charges actually seen.
      capabilities: { skills: [evaluation], tools: [read, calculate], permissions: [read-only] }
      outputSchema: { type: object, required: [score, passed, reasons, recommendation], properties: { score: { type: number }, passed: { type: boolean }, reasons: { type: array, items: { type: string } }, recommendation: { type: string, enum: [keep, downgrade, cancel] } } }
      config: { threshold: 0.6 }
    - id: decision
      kind: condition
      name: Keep, downgrade, or cancel
      summary: Route each subscription to its recommended action.
      config: { expression: "savings-evaluate.recommendation", branches: [ { label: "Keep", when: "keep" }, { label: "Downgrade", when: "downgrade" }, { label: "Cancel", when: "cancel" } ] }
    - id: result
      kind: output
      name: Subscription audit report
      summary: The recommended action for each subscription with the savings and confidence behind it.
  edges:
    - { id: e1, from: intake, to: dedupe-merchants, kind: data }
    - { id: e2, from: dedupe-merchants, to: usage-analyst, kind: data }
    - { id: e3, from: usage-analyst, to: savings-evaluate, kind: data }
    - { id: e4, from: savings-evaluate, to: decision, kind: data }
    - { id: e5, from: decision, to: result, kind: control, condition: "keep" }
    - { id: e6, from: decision, to: result, kind: control, condition: "downgrade" }
    - { id: e7, from: decision, to: result, kind: control, condition: "cancel" }
